archive.busy: {run} has tasks in progress ({tasks}); release them before archiving
archive.done: run {run} archived at {to}; it comes back with jtasks resume {run} --from-archive
archive.exists: there is already an archive of {run} at {to}
archive.none: there is no archive of run {run} at {from}
binding.other_run: this session is bound to run {run}; --run {asked} is refused
claim.already: {id} already has {files} in its ownership: nothing to do
claim.deadlock: claim refused: it would close a waiting cycle (deadlock): {chain}. Whoever asked last yields: {id}; do another part, or release with jtasks release {id}
claim.left: {id} stopped being in progress while it waited (it is {status})
claim.not_running: {id} is not in progress (it is {status}): claim only during the task
claim.odd: jlock answered {result} to the claim of {id}
claim.timeout: {id} waited {waited} s for {key}: still in use by {holder}{via}, position {position} in the queue. Options: ask again (jtasks claim {id} {files} --timeout 5m), do the part that does not depend on that file, or jtasks fail {id} --error "…"
clean.busy: refused: tasks in progress: {tasks}; release them first
clean.confirm: nothing was deleted; confirm with jtasks clean {which} --yes
clean.delete: delete {target}; the commits stay (they are code)
clean.delete_all: delete {target} ({n} run(s)); the commits stay (they are code)
clean.effects: effects still active (they stay; undo each with the command beside it, if you want):
doctor.claude_absent: Claude Code not found (nothing to check)
doctor.claude_mod_absent: the jtasks mod is not installed (/plugin install jtasks --marketplace rodrigojager/jtasks)
doctor.confirm: nothing was installed; confirm with jtasks doctor --fix --yes
doctor.file_differs: {file}: already there with other content, kept
doctor.fix_cli_only: doctor --fix runs in the CLI: run jtasks doctor --fix --yes in a terminal
doctor.git_fix: install git (https://git-scm.com) and open a new terminal
doctor.home_absent: {home}: not there yet (created on first use)
doctor.home_fix: point JTASKS_HOME at a folder you can write, or unset it
doctor.home_ok: {home}: a writable folder; global ledger with {n} effect(s)
doctor.jlock_doctor_unreadable: jlock {version}; jlock doctor --json did not answer JSON
doctor.jlock_install_fix: jtasks doctor --fix --yes installs it, or see https://github.com/rodrigojager/jlock
doctor.jlock_installed: jlock installed at {file} ({id}); open a new terminal if it is not in PATH yet
doctor.jlock_installed_somewhere: jlock installed (where its installer said); open a new terminal
setup.jlock_installed: jlock was missing and is now installed at {file} (jtasks undo {id} removes it)
setup.jlock_failed: jlock is missing and its automatic install failed ({message}); install it with: {command}
setup.jlock_not_found_after: the installer ended, but jlock is not where it puts it
doctor.opencode_ok: the agents execute, execute-deep and review are there; {plugin}
doctor.opencode_plugin_absent: the jtasks plugin is not in its configuration (see opencode/README.md)
doctor.opencode_plugin_listed: the jtasks plugin is in its configuration
doctor.skills_no_agents: no Claude Code, OpenCode or Codex folder in this home (nothing to check)
doctor.skills_ok: to-jtasks and jtasks are there for {agents}
doctor.step_jlock: install jlock with its official installer
done.claimed: claimed during the task: {files}; update the plan if other tasks touch them too
done.lost: ownership lost: {keys} is no longer held by {id} in jlock; done was refused (use jtasks release {id} and start again)
done.no_commit: no change in its ownership, no commit
done.no_evidence: done without evidence is refused: jtasks done {id} --evidence "what proves it is done"
done.outside: {id} cannot be done: files changed outside its ownership: {files}. Ask for them with jtasks claim {id} <file>, or undo those changes
done.wrong_branch: the checkout is on {branch}, but the run commits on {run_branch}
draft.already_open: a draft is already open: {ids} (go on with jtasks plan --add, or close it with --commit)
draft.batch_accepted: batch accepted: {n} task(s) ({ids}); the draft has {total}. Close it with jtasks plan --commit
draft.batch_refused: batch refused, the draft did not change.
draft.commit_refused: plan refused, nothing was written; the draft stays open.
draft.empty: the draft is empty: add tasks with jtasks plan --add
draft.empty_summary: draft {id}: no task yet (add some with jtasks plan --add)
draft.fix_id_changed: --fix {id} got the task {other}: the id does not change in a fix
draft.fix_needs_id: --fix needs the task's id: jtasks plan --fix T04 <json>
draft.fix_one: --fix replaces one task only: send an object
draft.fix_refused: fix of {id} refused, the draft did not change.
draft.many: {n} drafts are open ({ids}): say which with --run <id>
draft.no_task: the draft has no task {id} (see jtasks plan --show)
draft.none: no open draft: start one with jtasks plan --draft
draft.not_found: no open draft with the id {id}
draft.opened: draft {id} open: add batches with jtasks plan --add <json> (up to ~20 tasks per batch)
effects.checked: {n} active effect(s) checked against the disk and git
fail.no_error: fail without an error is refused: jtasks fail {id} --error "what went wrong"
gc.confirm: nothing was removed: confirm with jtasks gc --remove {path} --yes
gc.not_listed: {path} is not something the gc report lists (a worktree, a run or a run's archive); nothing was removed
gc.owner_orphan: owner {owner} (its repository does not know it: orphan)
gc.removed: {type} removed: {path} ({how}); recorded in the global ledger
gc.untouched: nothing was touched; to remove: jtasks gc --remove <path> --yes
gc.usage: use jtasks gc --scan <root> (a report) or jtasks gc --remove <path> --yes
gc.worktree_refused: git worktree remove refused: {message} (unsaved changes?); nothing was removed
git.not_a_repo: not a git repository: {cwd} (jtasks makes one commit per task)
guard.git: a subagent does not run git {sub}: the commit is made by jtasks done {id}
guard.outside: outside the ownership of {id}: {rel}; use jtasks claim {id} {rel}
guard.run_files: {rel}: tasks.json, run.json and the tickets change only through the jtasks tool; never by hand
help.archive: archive <run>                         moves the run to JTASKS_HOME/archive (resume brings it)
help.claim: claim <id> <file…> [--timeout 60s]    asks for one more file; waits in jlock's queue
help.clean: clean <run>|--all [--yes]             deletes the run's folder (listing the active effects first)
help.doctor: doctor [--fix [--yes]]                is this machine ready? --fix --yes installs what is missing
help.done: done <id> --evidence "…"              checks git and ownership; commits the ownership; done
help.effects: effects --check                       compares the ledger with the disk and git
help.exec: exec -- <command…>                    runs it; serialize commands one at a time on the machine
help.fail: fail <id> --error "…"                 failed (blocks the tasks that depend on it)
help.gc: gc --scan <root> [--depth 4]          read-only report: orphan worktrees, runs, archives
help.import: import <folder> [--check|--yes]       Markdown tickets → a run (no Files → exclusive)
help.json: --json on any action: the answer in JSON; --run <id> picks the run
help.lang: --lang <tag>: the language of the answers (en, pt-BR, ...); also JTASKS_LANG, then JLOCK_LANG
help.ledger: ledger [--all-projects]               everything the tool created: type, ref, run, task, state
help.next: next [limit]                          the ready tasks: profile, criteria, ownership and ticket
help.pause: pause / unpause                       paused: start refused; the protocol says stop
help.plan: plan <json|@file> [--name slug]       creates the run (tasks.json, tickets, branch gt/<run>)
help.plan.add: plan --add <json|@file>               adds a batch to the draft (validates the batch)
help.plan.commit: plan --commit                         complete validation; creates the run and deletes the draft
help.plan.draft: plan --draft [--name slug] [--objective text] [--source ref]   opens a draft (a plan in batches)
help.plan.fix: plan --fix <id> <json|@file>          replaces one task of the draft
help.plan.show: plan --show                           a summary of the draft
help.release: release <id>                          in progress → pending (at maxAttempts, failed)
help.resume: resume <run> [--keep-owners]          binds the session, unpauses, releases tasks without locks
help.keepalive: keepalive on|off                      the host reopens an idle loop that has ready tasks
help.runs: runs                                  the repository's runs, with status and progress
help.skip: skip <id> --reason "…"                skipped (frees the tasks that depend on it)
help.start: start <id>                            in progress; locks the ownership (jlock hold --no-wait)
help.status: status                                done D/T (P%) · … · N left, the frontier and the locks
help.status.run: (without --run: the session's run, JTASKS_RUN, or the repository's only active one)
help.title: jtasks {version}: a task list with dependencies and file ownership (jlock)
help.undo:
undo <e-id> | --task <id> | --run <run> [--force]
                                        undoes newest first (revert, branch, exclude, folder)
help.validate: validate <json|@file|folder>          validates a plan (or a folder of tickets) without writing
import.no_files: no Files: it becomes exclusive (never in parallel) until someone declares the files
import.no_folder: missing the tickets' folder: jtasks import <folder> [--check|--yes]
import.no_heading: no '# NN: title' heading (used the file name)
import.valid: the plan read is valid; create the run with --yes
jlock.hold_not_json: jlock hold answered something that is not JSON: {text}
jlock.hold_not_json_code: jlock hold answered something that is not JSON (exit {code}): {text}
jlock.hold_silent: jlock hold did not answer in {seconds} s
jlock.list_not_json: jlock list answered something that is not JSON: {text}
jlock.missing: jlock not found in PATH ({message}); install jlock or set JLOCK_BIN
jlock.no_version: jlock --version did not answer a version
jlock.too_old: jlock {version} is too old (at least {minimum}): update it with jlock update
jlock.usage: jlock ({what}) refused the usage: {message}; a jtasks bug, please report it
json.no_stdin: standard input is not available here
mod.command: Opens or closes the Tasks pane (jtasks)
mod.guard_failed: jtasks: the ownership guard failed in this call; it was refused to be safe
mod.no_session: jtasks: the session has not started yet (session.start)
mod.pane_no_room: The Tasks pane did not fit now: {reason}
mod.profile_failed: jtasks: could not read the task's profile; try again
mod.tool_failed: jtasks: the tool failed in this call; try again (jtasks status)
next.paused: the run is paused: do not start tasks
next.ready: ready ({n}) in {run}; they can run in parallel:
pause.done: run {run} paused: start refused, do not start tasks
keepalive.on: run {run}: keepalive on (the host reopens the loop when the orchestrator stops with ready tasks and nothing running)
keepalive.off: run {run}: keepalive off (only the model keeps the loop going)
keepalive.stalled: run {run} is stopped with {what} to do and nothing running; {tries} message(s) without progress, the host gave up (jtasks keepalive on watches it again)
keepalive.error: the run {run} stopped on an error with {what} to do and nothing running; after an error the host sends nothing (send a message to go on)
keepalive.dropped: jtasks: keepalive message no longer needed (the run moved on)
plan.absolute_path: {path}: use paths relative to the repository
plan.detached: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch before the plan (or use "branch": "current")
plan.hold_ttl: "holdTtl" must be a duration such as 30m, 2h or 1d
plan.max_attempts: "maxAttempts" must be an integer above zero
plan.missing_dependency: {id} depends on {dep}, which does not exist
plan.no_commits: the repository has no commits yet: make the first commit before the plan (the run's branch starts from it)
plan.pattern: {path}: jlock locks files and folders, not patterns; {hint}
plan.pattern_hint: list the files, use a folder or mark the task exclusive
plan.pattern_hint_folder: list the files or use the folder {folder}
plan.profile_object: profile "{name}" must be an object ({ claude, opencode })
plan.serialize_list: "serialize" must be a list of commands
plan.shape: the plan must be a list of tasks or an object with "tasks"
plan.shared: {a} and {b} touch {path}{cover} and may run together: add a dependency or split the file
plan.task_acceptance: {name}: "acceptance" must be a list of criteria (text)
plan.task_depends_list: {name}: "dependsOn" must be a list of ids
plan.task_files_list: {name}: "files" must be a list of paths
plan.task_object: {name}: each task must be an object
profiles.agent_missing: warning: the profile "{profile}" names the agent "{agent}", which does not exist: install the jtasks agents with jtasks doctor --fix, or name one of your agents in the plan
release.failed: the ownership was not given back ({message}); use jlock release --group {run} --owner {owner}
resume.no_locks_reason: agent without locks in jlock (window closed)
retry.cannot: {id} is {status}: retry only reopens a skipped or failed task
run.many: {n} runs are active ({ids}): say which with --run <id>
run.none: no run in this repository (create one with jtasks plan; see jtasks runs)
run.not_found: run not found in this repository: {run} (see jtasks runs)
runs.none: no run in this repository (create one with jtasks plan)
skip.no_reason: skip without a reason is refused: jtasks skip {id} --reason "why"
spawn.other_run: --run {run} is not the run bound to this session ({bound})
start.busy: {id} was not ready: {key} in use by {holder}{via}; nothing was written
start.depends: {id} is not ready: it depends on {deps}
start.hint: another file: jtasks claim {id} <file>; at the end: jtasks done {id} --evidence "…" (or jtasks fail {id} --error "…")
start.locked: ownership locked in jlock ({n} key(s), owner {owner})
start.paused: run {run} is paused: do not start tasks
status.lost_task: {id} (no locks in jlock: jtasks resume or jtasks release {id})
status.keepalive_stalled: keepalive gave up: {what} to do, nothing running, {tries} message(s) without progress (jtasks keepalive on watches it again)
status.keepalive_error: keepalive stopped after an error: {what} to do, nothing running (send a message to go on)
status.keepalive_held: keepalive: quiet after an interruption, until the run moves
status.keepalive_nudged: keepalive: reopened the loop at {at} (message {tries} of {max})
store.locked: the run has been locked for writing for more than {seconds} s: {lock}
store.stale: tasks.json changed while this action ran (revision {expected} → {found}); read it again and retry
undo.branch_dirty: {id}: {branch} is checked out with unsaved changes ({files})
undo.dirty: {id}: the tree has unsaved changes ({files}); commit or discard them before the undo
undo.exclude_shared: {id}: other runs still use the line {line} of the exclude ({runs}); use --force to take it out anyway
undo.line_absent: {id}: the line was no longer in {path}
undo.no_commit: {id}: the commit {ref} no longer exists (see jtasks effects --check)
undo.no_effect: no active effect {id} in run {run} (see jtasks ledger)
undo.no_global: no active global effect {id} (see jtasks ledger --all-projects)
undo.none: {id}: there is no automatic undo for {type} ({kind})
undo.revert_failed: {id}: git revert {ref} did not apply cleanly: {message}
undo.run_busy: {id}: the run has tasks in progress ({tasks}); release them first
undo.task_clean: {id} has no active effects to undo
undo.task_running: {id} is in progress: release it (jtasks release {id}) before the undo
undo.unmerged: {id}: the branch {branch} has commits that are not in {base}; merge them (git merge) or use --force
undo.which: say what to undo: jtasks undo <e-id> | --task <id> | --run <run>
